To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
GKRS is effective and safe in the management of unusual LGPNT, particularly in children and young patients.

1) GKRS can be considered a first choice option in the treatment of LGPNTs; 2) GKRS is a safe and effective treatment for the management of LGPNT; 3) the long-term outcome of GKRS in patients with LGPNTs is comparable with those reported in patients with pilocytic and diffused astrocytomas.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the assessment of the long term efficacy and toxicity of GKRS in a series of patients affected by unusual LGPNT.
the following questions: * What are the indications for GKRS in LGPNTs?
the assessment of the long-term efficacy and safety of GKRS as a primary or salvage treatment in a wide spectrum of LGPNTs, which are often difficult to treat with conventional therapies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the role of GKRS in LGPNTs of the brain is not well established yet.
GKRS is an effective and safe tool in the multidiscliplinary management of pilocytic (G1) and diffuse (GI) astrocytomas, of the cerebellum and the brainstem, respectively.
GKRS represents a valuable therapeutic option in a variety of LGPNTs, with a high rate of tumor control and an acceptable risk of radiation-induced complications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GKRS may represent an effective and safe treatment option in the management of LGPNTs, even in unusual histotypes.
the application of GK in the treatment of LGPNTs is still controversial.
GKRS may be considered an effective treatment option in the management of LGPNTs, even though the reported long-term TGC and OS is not so good as in pilocytic and diffused astrocytomas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of GKRS is a safe and effective therapeutic tool in the management of unusual Grade I and II LGPNTs.
GKRS is an effective and safe option in the management of a wide spectrum of unusual Grade I/II LGPNTs of the brain.
GKRS is a safe and effective treatment option in a wide spectrum of unusual grade I/II primitive neuroepithelial brain tumours.
